_comment: WP-K4c: the game effects the SCFxBuild commandlet rebuilds as Niagara systems under /Game/SC/FX (plugins/SCBridge/Source/SCBridgeFx). effects: particle effect references <GUID>|<library>.<effect> (GUIDs from Data/Libs/Particles/<library>.xml); Gadgets/tractor_beam.fps.muzzle_1st has every emitter disabled in LIVE 4.10.2, the multitool tractor record fires tractorbeam/fps_tractorbeam.FPS_Tractor_Beam.Muzzleflash_1st (a light). material_effects: MaterialEffects FXLib entries <lib>:<effect>; each builds the particle effects it plays. unlit_diffuse_scene_units: the viewer's stand-in for scene lighting on particles without EmissiveLighting (the masters are unlit): the luminance, in game scene units (FSCStarEngine::SceneUnitNits cd/m2 each), of a white DiffuseLighting=1 particle. A viewer approximation, not game data: 0.35 from the WP-K4c aesthetic review (out/fk4c/astra/final-1.md: smoke 2-4x too self-luminous at 1). strength: the DataCore record whose struct of the given type names the game strengths an effect EmitterStrength curve is evaluated at (its numeric fields in 0..1, blend coefficients and scales excluded; range_field: the beam range, metres, of the struct owner, for the beam bounds). SCFxBuild bakes the curves as polynomials in User.SC.Strength through those strengths. flare_world_scale: lens-flare elements are sized 2 x emitter Size x element Size x Scale metres x this factor (CryEngine sizes flares on screen; the factor is a viewer stand-in, chosen by the WP-K4c aesthetic review: out/fk4c/astra/item4-7-1.md).
runtime_comment: Read at run time by the cargo drones and boxes (FSCCargoFx, WP-K4c hook-up). The effects themselves come from the data: the tractor record's beam, muzzle and hit (a MaterialEffects custom effect) and a ship record's CollisionMFXEntityParams.customEffect, resolved through MaterialEffects.xml for the boxes' surface group and the FXLib entry's first particle effect; each finds its system by the SCFxNames.h rule. Viewer stand-ins: box_surface_group is the fx group of the carryable boxes' surface (metal_dense -> metal in SurfaceTypes.xml, the WP-K4c survey of all 2183 carryable_* records; no box surface reaches the runtime). A box knocking a ship plays its effect when its speed change along the contact normal is at least contact_min_speed_cm_s (CryEngine's collision MFX thresholds are engine settings, not data), at most once per contact_min_interval_s per box; the FXLib entry's minscale..maxscale is spread over contact_min_speed_cm_s..contact_full_speed_cm_s (the data gives no rule between; the ships' metal entries have minscale = maxscale). 100 and 350 cm/s from the WP-K4a review (out/k4a/astra/fx.md).
